item.name: Shared San Andreas Fault Jeep Tour
item.unicode: Shared San Andreas Fault Jeep Tour
item.description:
>### TOUR HIGHLIGHTS

>* Journey through a labyrinth of geological cuts and canyons of the San Andreas Fault Zone.  
>* Learn about the plants, animals, geology, and seismology of the San Andreas Fault.  
>* Take a guided nature walk through a slot canyon.  
>* Take an optional hike to a natural palm oasis..
>* Tour a recreated Cahuilla Indian Village adorned with interpretive displays and learn how the Cahuilla People lived in this arid, inhospitable environment.

>### ABOUT THE EXPERIENCE
>* The tour we offer is a soft-adventure and is safe and suitable for guests aged 5 and up.   The most challenging part of the tour for some guests is climbing in and out of the Jeep, but we have step-stools to make that easier for you.  Your guide is also happy to lend a hand if you need assistance.
>* The experience we provide is designed to be educational, entertaining, and engaging.  You will stop several times and get out of the Jeep for short nature walks or an easy hike.  Most of the nature walks/hikes are only 10 or 15 minutes long.  So guests who may have mobility issues are welcome to wait at the Jeep while the rest of the group explores the trail.
>* Our guides are very knowledgable and they will provide a lot of interesting information about the area.  You will learn about the desert plants, animals, geology, earthquakes and seismology, the Cahuilla Indians, and more.  But don't hesitate to tell your guide if you have particular interests.  They are happy to tailor the tour to guest preferences.
>* While you will travel on dirt roads and through remote desert washes, the ride is not extreme.    The Jeeps do not go up/down any steep inclines or do any "rock climbing" over boulders.  You will get bounced around some, but the Jeeps go slow.  It is not our goal to "beat you up" on the ride.
>* This tour may not be suitable for guests seeking an extreme adventure and some find our tour to be "milder" than they have experienced on Jeep Tours in other areas.   Our tour is about showcasing the beauty of the desert and providing a memorable experience.  
>* For your safety, seat belts are required at all times when the Jeep is moving. 

>###INCLUSIONS

>* Naturalist guided tour in a classic open-air Jeep Scrambler (CJ-8) with removable canvas shade top
>* Shared (non-private) tour for up to 7 guests per Jeep
>* Guided nature walks or easy hikes (accommodations for guests with limited mobilty are available)
>* Admission fees and taxes
>* Bottled water and granola snacks

### KNOW BEFORE YOU GO

- Please wear closed-toe-shoes with rubber soles (such as tennis shoes or hiking boots).  Sandals, flip-flops, and shoes with high heels are not recommended.
- Wear comfortable clothing - we recommend you dress in layers as desert temperatures can change quickly.  In the cooler months (November through March), we suggest you bring a sweater or light jacket for morning tours.  However, we do have blankets in the Jeeps in case you get chilly.
- Contact lens wearers may want to switch to eyeglasses or wear eye protection (such as sunglasses), as tours can be dusty at times.
- Be sure to drink plenty of water and stay hydrated before and after your tour, especially in the warmer months.  
- Bring a hat and sunglasses and apply sunscreen before the tour.  The desert sun is strong and you can burn easily with the reflection off the sand. 
- We supply plenty of cool bottled water and granola bars.  While we ask that you refrain from bringing any outside food or beverage on tour with you,  you are welcome to bring snacks and drinks for your young children.
- There are portable restrooms available on the property and the Jeeps will stop a couple of times for bathroom breaks. 
- Don't forget your camera or video camera - the photo opportunities are Instagram worthy and we would love if you would tag us on your social media **@RedJeepTours @MetateRanch @DesertAdventuresPS**.

*********************************************

###RESERVATIONS

* Advance Reservations are required and are subject to availability. 
* There is a minimum of 2 guests required to operate this tour.  Tour is subject to cancellation if this minimum is not met.  
* We have a 48-hour cancellation policy.  There are no refunds or credit for no-shows.
* Online reservations require a minimum of 2 guests to book.  If you are a single rider, please call (760) 324-5337 or email [resv@red-jeep.com](mailto:resv@red-jeep.com) to inquire about joining an existing tour.  
* Guests redeeming a gift certificate with a 4-digit code must call (760) 324-5337 or email [resv@red-jeep.com](mailto:resv@red-jeep.com) to book.  Gift Cards (with a 20-digit code) may be redeemed online. 
* Private and group tours are also offered. Please [contact us](mailto:info@red-jeep.com) for more information.

*********************************************

###TOUR DURATION
* 3.0 hours from our meeting point in Indio

*********************************************

###DEPARTURE TIME AND LOCATION
* Please review your tour confirmation for details about your departure time and meeting point.  
* Hotel pickup is not offered on shared tours but is offered as an option on private tours.  
* There is plenty of free parking at our meeting point.
* **Be sure to lock your valuables in your trunk or take them with you.**  Do not leave your valuables where they can be seen through your windows.  Break-ins tend to be crimes of opportunity.
* If you will be using a ride-share service (such as Uber), please let your guide know at the beginning of your tour so that they can assist you with scheduling your return pickup.

*********************************************

###GROUP SIZE

* Each Jeep holds a maximum of 7 guests plus your driver/guide.  
* The vehicle configuration is 1 guest in the front passenger seat (next to the driver) and 6 guests in the back (on two inward-facing bench seats that accommodate three guests each).  
* If you have very tall (6'2" or taller) or larger guests (over 250 lbs) in your party, please let us know when booking.  We do our best to provide comfortable seating for all.  

*********************************************

### TOUR ADVISORIES

* **Proper footwear (hiking boots or walking/tennis shoes) is required.**  Please no open-toe shoes, sandals, or flip-flops or shoes with high heels.
* This tour includes getting in and out of the Jeep several times for several short nature walks or easy hikes.  Please let us know if anyone in your party will need assistance or has limited mobility so that appropriate accommodations can be made.  
* Guests who are pregnant (high-risk or late-term) or who have neck or back issues or injuries should consult with their doctor before taking this tour.  While this is not an extreme adventure, you will get jostled around some in the Jeep.  The front, passenger seat  is recommended for guests with mild neck or back issues, as it will provide the most comfortable ride.

*********************************************

### CHILD POLICY

* **The minimum age for children on shared tours is 5 years.**  
* Children under the age of 8 or less than 4' 9" tall should ride in a booster seat (provided by the parents). 
* Booster seats must be placed in the rear, side-facing seats and we recommend placing them in the middle between 2 adults.  
* Booster seats are secured by a 2-point lap belt.  Our Jeeps are not equipped with shoulder belts, so they cannot secure a child safety seat that rquires a 3-point harness.    Therefore we do not recommend the tour for children who are not big enough to ride in a booster seat. 

*********************************************

### PET POLICY

* While service dogs are welcome, family pets are not allowed on shared tours.   If you would like to bring your dog on tour, we suggest you book a private tour, where well-behaved dogs are permitted.  
* Please let us know in advance if you will be bringing a service animal with you.  
* Cats and other animals are not permitted.

*********************************************

### WEATHER POLICY

* All of our tours take place as scheduled: rain or shine, cloudy or clear, hot or cold. Thus, you should dress appropriately for the weather. 
* At Desert Adventures' sole discretion, tours may be altered to accommodate changes in weather so as to provide the safest and most enjoyable experience possible. 
* If light rain is predicted, we have rain ponchos for you to use.  If heavy rains are expected or there are any flash flood advisories or warnings, then the tour will be cancelled or rescheduled.  We prioritize your safety above all else. 
* If you wish to cancel your tour due to forecasted inclement weather when we deem it safe to operate, our normal cancellations and refund policy will apply. However, we will allow you to reschedule your tour to a different day or time at no charge, subject to space availability.
* If we cancel a tour due to weather or safety concerns, you will given the option to reschedule your tour at no charge (subject to space availability) or we can issue a gift card that you can use at a later date, or we can provide a refund back to your original method of payment.  Refunds and credits may be prorated, based on the circumstances.

*********************************************

### GUIDE GRATUTIES

* Tour guide gratuities are not included in the tour cost, but are appreciated.
* The suggested gratuity is 10-15% of the retail tour price, but tips are at your sole discretion.
* Gratuities paid directly to your guide are preferred and most guides can accept tips via Venmo or Zelle as well as cash.  
* However, if you would like to add a gratuity to the credit card you used to book your tour, please [contact us](mailto:resv@red-jeep.com) and we can add that on for you.
item.booking_notes:
### WHAT'S INCLUDED

* Private, naturalist-led tour in a classic open-air Jeep Scrambler (CJ-8) with removable canvas shade top
* Accommodates up to 7 guests per Jeep — tour is tailored to your interests
* Guided hike or easy nature walk
* All admission fees and taxes
* Bottled water and granola snacks

*********************************************  

### WHAT'S NOT INCLUDED

Gratuities are not included in the tour price, but they are a meaningful part of our guides’ income and are sincerely appreciated if you feel your guide provided an outstanding experience.

While tipping is always optional, the suggested gratuity is 10–15% of the tour price. If you’re unsure what’s appropriate, consider it similar to tipping at a restaurant—if your guide made your tour fun, engaging, and memorable, a tip is a great way to show your appreciation.

Most guides accept tips via cash, Venmo, or Zelle—just ask them at the end of the tour.

If you'd prefer to add a gratuity to the credit card used for booking, just contact us and we’ll be happy to assist and provide a receipt.

*********************************************  
### HELPFUL TIPS BEFORE YOU GO

* **Wear proper footwear.** Closed-toe shoes with rubber soles (tennis shoes or hiking boots) are required. Please skip the sandals, flip-flops, and heels.

* **Dress in layers.** Desert temps shift fast! A sweater or light jacket is a good idea for morning tours, especially November through March. We also keep blankets in the Jeeps if you get chilly.

* **Stay hydrated.** Drink plenty of water before and after your tour — especially in the warmer months.

* **Sun protection is key.** Bring a hat, wear sunglasses, and apply sunscreen before your tour. Desert sun reflects off the sand and can sneak up on you.

* **Snacks and drinks.** We provide bottled water and granola bars. You're welcome to pre-order additional snacks and beverages if you’d like to customize your tour. Please avoid bringing outside food or drink unless it’s for young children.

* **Restroom access.** Portable toilets are available.

* **No Unaccompanied Minors:** An adult must accompany children **under 18.**

* **Bring your camera!** You'll encounter countless Instagram-worthy photo and video opportunities. Share your tour memories and tag us for a chance to be featured on our Facebook and Instagram pages!	**@RedJeepTours #RedJeepTours #Metate Ranch**

* Meet your Jeep and guide in the parking lot.  They will pick you up there.  Park toward the front of the lot by the signs and yellow chain.

*********************************************

### LIABILITY WAIVERS

* All guests are required to sign a **liability waiver.**
* A parent or legal guardian must sign the liability waiver for children **under 18.**

*********************************************  

### MOBILITY-RESTRICTED GUESTS

* If anyone in your group needs assistance or has limited mobility, please inform us to arrange appropriate accommodations.

* For some guests, the most challenging part of the tour may be getting in and out of the Jeep; however, we provide step stools to make this easier. Your guide is also available to assist as needed.

* The Jeep will stop several times for short nature walks or easy hikes, typically lasting about **10 to 15 minutes.**

* Guests with mobility challenges are welcome to remain at the Jeep while the rest of the group explores.

*********************************************  

### TOUR ADVISORIES

* Guests who are **pregnant** (especially those who are high-risk or in the late stages of pregnancy) or who have **neck or back issues or other injuries** should consult with their doctor before participating in this tour.

* While this is not an extreme adventure, some jostling in the Jeep is to be expected.

* For guests with mild neck or back issues, or those concerned about a bumpy ride, we recommend the front passenger seat, which offers the most comfortable experience.  

* The front passenger seat is also a good option for guests needing additional assistance or with special needs.


*********************************************  
### OTHER RESOURCES

* [Frequently Asked Questions](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/IYTSmWWCQ2CQo1h430ya)

* [PDF of Tour Details](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/C53Cnz3RliDQzhdICKMF)

* [Directions to the Meeting Point](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/tFXybPQbQpmB6ldB10Pa)
item.cancellation_notes:
Plans change—we understand. You may cancel your reservation for any reason up to 48 hours prior to your scheduled departure and receive a full refund.

Refunds will be issued to the original method of payment. Alternatively, we are happy to provide a gift card for the full refundable amount. Gift cards never expire, are fully transferable, and may be used toward any of our tours or experiences.

Cancellations received within 48 hours of departure, no-shows, and missed tours are non-refundable and not eligible for credit unless Trip Cancellation Insurance was purchased and the cancellation qualifies under the terms of that coverage.
item.no_transportation_notes:
### MEETING POINT

***All tours begin and end at Metate Ranch***
* **[Google Map Link to Metate Ranch](https://g.page/MetateRanch?share)**

There is not an actual physical address for Metate Ranch, but you can use this address for navigation in Google Maps:  **38635 Monroe St, Indio, CA 92203** 

We are listed on Google Maps as **Metate Ranch | San Andreas Fault Jeep Tour** or we should come up if you just Google  ***Metate Ranch.***

>  If you search for us under either "**Desert Adventures**" or "**Red Jeep Tours,**" a few different listings may come up.  So, be sure to follow the directions to our **Monroe Street location in Indio**, ***NOT*** our office in Palm Desert on Lennon Place. 
 
Google uses two different routes to Metate Ranch from the I-10 freeway.  One exits the I-10 freeway at Jefferson Street and the other exits the I-10 freeway at Monroe Street.  Either will get you to us - just follow the directions Google give; they are accurate. 

**A couple of things to note:**

* We are located on the NORTH side of the water canal and berm - up against the Indio Hills.  So take Monroe Street until you cross **Avenue 40** and then go up and over a little hill (the berm).   Look for the signs for the **Red Jeep Tours/Metate Ranch** and the **Coachella Valley Horse Rescue** as you go up the hill.

* Once you reach the top of the berm, you’ll see the Hi-Grade Materials / Granite Construction Quarry directly in front of you.  They have a big white gate and big sign that says Granite Construction.   
>* **Halfway** between the berm and the Hi-Grade Materials / Granite Construction gate is a dirt road that goes off to the right (east).  **YOU WILL TURN RIGHT ONTO THIS DIRT ROAD.**  

>As you come down the north side of the berm, **look for the signs** for Red Jeep Tours/Metate Ranch.

>* You want to **TURN RIGHT** at the signs for *Metate Ranch/Red Jeep Tours* and the *Coachella Valley Horse Rescue*.

If you get to the Granite Construction / Hi-Grade Gate, you went too far on the paved road. Turn around and go back a few hundred feet - look for the dirt-road turn-off on your left as you are heading back south on Monroe Street.

Please [email us](mailto:resv@red-jeep.com) or call (760) 324-5337 if you have any questions about where to park for your tour. 

>**Be sure to lock your valuables in your trunk or take them with you.** Avoid leaving items visible through your car's windows, as even a small amount of change in a cup holder can attract unwanted attention. Break-ins are often crimes of opportunity, so protect yourself by securing all valuables in your trunk or bringing them with you.
  
**There is no charge for parking.**


*Parking will be in the **Metate Ranch Parking Lot** just off Monroe Street.  
* Once you turn right onto the dirt road at the Metate Ranch/Red Jeep Tours and Coachella Valley Horse Rescue signs, you will make a left turn into the big dirt parking lot.  
* **Park in the area designated by the cones.**

#### Follow the red line to the Metate Ranch Parking Lot.  

[Click here for larger map.](https://www.google.com/maps/d/u/0/edit?mid=12wkudJZjD1QXR0xUjPzlW4yiMW44U8U&usp=sharing)

![Follow the red line to the Metate Ranch Parking Lot](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/GtM5iMNfRMmHgeABZZtg)

>If you need help finding the **Meeting Point**, give us a call at **(760) 324-5337**, Ext 1.
